answer: For a ridge survey of marble and ferrous deposits, publish a fixed grid of sampling cells and one bounty per cell. An approved lab witnesses sampling and signs the cell ID, assay and claimant key. Validators check the signature and pay that cell's bounty once across all keys. Ten aliases submitting the same cell cannot earn ten payments; another reward requires sampling and assaying another unpaid cell. This binds revenue to completed fieldwork, not registrations. Colluding labs can certify fictitious samples, so lab integrity remains a trust assumption.
